ctx.x: Hi Bill, this is Floyd Levin in Los Angeles. This is the 25th of July 1969 and shortly I expect Barney Begard over, at which time I will supply the questions and hopefully he'll come up with some of the answers to help you on your quest for information about Jelly Roll Morton. Okay, we've just played the Victor Trio session, Barney. I assume that you have some memories about that session. Yeah, I was really surprised. I thought I played more than I do now.
